privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How your information is used on this website.
privacy.controllerBody: Ricardo Silva Lopes EI is responsible for personal data processing associated with this portfolio and your contact enquiries.
privacy.collectionBody: The form asks for your name, email address, project type and description. These fields are required to submit the form; you can also write directly by email. The page language is submitted too. For a quote or service you request on your own behalf, processing is based on pre-contractual steps taken at your request (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)). For other enquiries, including those made on behalf of a business, it is based on Ricardo Lopes’s legitimate interest in responding to professional enquiries (Article 6(1)(f)). These details are not used for a newsletter. Please avoid sending sensitive information or details unrelated to your project.
privacy.processingBody: Ricardo Lopes receives your enquiries. Netlify hosts the website, stores submissions in Netlify Forms and sends notifications to Gmail (Google). Netlify’s documentation describes spam filtering through Akismet (Automattic). Messages sent directly to contact@rlopes.pt are forwarded through Cloudflare Email Routing to Gmail, from which Ricardo Lopes replies. These services may involve transfers outside the European Economic Area, including to the United States. Netlify’s agreement describes the safeguards it provides, including standard contractual clauses where applicable. The safeguards that actually apply to the services used still need confirmation before production launch. You can request further details or a copy of the safeguards using the contact address.
privacy.retentionBody: Messages currently remain in the mailbox without a formal deletion schedule. The proposed policy is to delete enquiries that do not result in projects within 12 months of the last contact, through periodic deletion that still needs to be put in place. It must cover both the mailbox and submissions stored in Netlify Forms. This process is not yet implemented or automated. For actual clients, retention should follow contractual needs and applicable legal obligations.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, correction, deletion or restriction of your data, and portability where applicable. You may also object, on grounds relating to your situation, to processing based on legitimate interests. Write to the contact address listed on this page. You may lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, CNIL.
privacy.cookiesBody: The portfolio does not load advertising scripts, tracking pixels or audience analytics tools in your browser. The functional NEXT_LOCALE cookie is created only when you choose a language. It contains the code fr, pt or en, is limited to the domain you visit and expires one year after your last explicit choice; ordinary browsing does not extend that period. Its only purpose is to remember your language, without a tracking identifier. The portfolio does not use localStorage or sessionStorage to store information. Fonts and images are served from this website.
privacy.technicalBody: To serve pages and keep the website secure, Netlify receives technical information such as your IP address, the date and time, the requested URL and browser information. Security and diagnostics rely on the legitimate interest in maintaining a reliable website and preventing abuse. The form also includes a technical field to help prevent spam. Log retention periods and any server-side analytics or other integrations enabled in the Netlify account still need verification. The absence of browser trackers does not establish the absence of server-side processing.
privacy.preferencesBody: You can change language at any time using the selector at the top or bottom of the page. To remove this preference, delete the NEXT_LOCALE cookie in your browser settings; you can also block cookies. Navigation and the contact form remain available. Without a saved preference, the home address without a language code opens the French version. This cookie is limited to the language preference you request and is exempt from prior consent.
privacy.externalBody: Links to projects, GitHub, LinkedIn, CNIL or Netlify documents are ordinary links, without embedded social widgets, videos or maps. They do not load these services until you open them. Once you follow a link, the destination website’s policy applies.
